Unitree now offers three major humanoid robot platforms: Unitree R1 , Unitree G1 , and Unitree H2 . Each platform serves a different buyer: entry-level robotics education, AI research, commercial demos, embodied AI development, and full-size humanoid applications. Quick Recommendation Robot Best For Why Choose It Unitree R1 Education, entry-level humanoid research, demos, budget buyers Lowest starting price, lightweight design, easy entry into humanoid robotics Unitree G1 AI research, universities, manipulation research, lab development Balanced size, stronger development ecosystem, optional dexterous hands Unitree H2 Advanced R&D, full-size humanoid development, commercial showcase 180 cm class humanoid, higher payload, stronger computing and physical capability Key Specification Comparison Specification Unitree R1 Unitree G1 Unitree H2 Edu Version Starting Price $15,950 $43,900 $68,900 Height 1230 mm 1320 mm 1820 mm Weight About 27–29 kg About 35 kg About 70 kg Degrees of Freedom 20–40 depending on version 23–43 depending on version 31 Battery Life About 1 hour About 2 hours About 3 hours Secondary Development EDU version only G1 EDU version only H2 EDU version only Best Use Case Affordable humanoid learning and demos Research, AI, robotics development Full-size humanoid R&D and commercial applications Unitree R1: Best Entry-Level Humanoid Robot The Unitree R1 humanoid robot is the most affordable option in the Unitree humanoid lineup. With a starting price of $4,900, a compact 1230 mm body, and a lightweight 27–29 kg design, R1 is ideal for schools, universities, robotics clubs, AI labs, and companies that want an accessible humanoid robot platform. R1 is best for buyers who want to explore humanoid movement, voice interaction, perception, and basic AI demonstrations without investing in a larger research platform. The R1 EDU version is the recommended choice for developers who need secondary development access. Unitree G1: Best Balanced Platform for Research and Development The Unitree G1 humanoid robot is the best all-around choice for most research labs and universities. It offers a stronger balance of cost, mobility, size, sensing, and manipulation capability. G1 supports 23 to 43 degrees of freedom depending on configuration, with optional dexterous hands on EDU versions. Compared with R1, G1 is better for serious humanoid robot research, embodied AI, reinforcement learning, teleoperation, motion control, and manipulation research. Compared with H2, G1 is easier to deploy in classrooms, labs, offices, and demo environments. Unitree H2: Best Full-Size Humanoid Robot Platform The Unitree H2 humanoid robot is a full-size humanoid platform designed for advanced embodied AI development and high-impact commercial demonstration. With a height of 1820 mm, weight of about 70 kg, 31 degrees of freedom, and about 3 hours of battery life, H2 is the most capable physical platform among the three. H2 is the best choice for advanced robotics teams, corporate R&D groups, humanoid AI companies, industrial research labs, and organizations that need a more human-scale platform for movement, perception, interaction, and manipulation development. Applications by Platform Unitree R1 Applications STEM education and robotics teaching Entry-level humanoid robot research AI demonstrations and public events University robotics labs with limited budget Basic motion, perception, and interaction testing Unitree G1 Applications Embodied AI research Humanoid locomotion research Dexterous hand and manipulation research Teleoperation and robot learning University, lab, and commercial R&D projects Unitree H2 Applications Full-size humanoid robot development Advanced AI model deployment Commercial showroom and exhibition demos Human-scale robot interaction research Industrial and enterprise humanoid R&D Who Should Buy Which Unitree Humanoid Robot? Choose Unitree R1 if: You want the lowest-cost humanoid robot platform, mainly for education, demos, entry-level research, or learning humanoid robotics. Choose Unitree G1 if: You need the best balance between price, development capability, size, and research flexibility. For most universities and AI labs, G1 EDU is the strongest recommendation. Choose Unitree H2 if: You need a full-size humanoid robot with stronger physical presence, higher payload capability, longer battery life, and more advanced commercial or research potential. Final Recommendation For most buyers, Unitree G1 EDU is the best overall humanoid robot platform because it offers the strongest balance of research capability, price, size, and upgrade options. Unitree R1 is the best budget-friendly choice for education and entry-level humanoid robotics. Unitree H2 is the best option for advanced teams that need a full-size humanoid robot for serious embodied AI and commercial development. Need Help Choosing a Unitree Humanoid Robot?
